commits.subject: Reject published test keys as release keys in production builds
commits.original_message:
Reject published test keys as release keys in production builds

SEC-44 / E-21: GHOSTPAY_RELEASE_PUBKEYS parsing had no denylist, so the
public Playwright manifest-signing key (secret 0x07*32) could verify a
release build's manifests. parseReleaseKeys now refuses every key in
PUBLIC_TEST_RELEASE_KEYS (repeated-byte fixture secrets 0x01..0x10, the
default anvil accounts, scalars 1..3) when the build is a release:
explicit `production`, else GP_COMMIT is a full commit id and
GHOSTPAY_PAGES_DEV is not 1. build-pages.sh checks explicitly for a
release Pages build and passes GHOSTPAY_PAGES_DEV to the Vite build so
the dev-mode Pages acceptance keeps its fixture key.

commits.subject: Attest the Pages artifact checksums before deploying
commits.original_message:
Attest the Pages artifact checksums before deploying

SEC-43: the served files' SHA256SUMS existed only in the run summary and
a 14-day artifact, unsigned, so nothing durable bound the published site
to this repository's workflow. A new attest job (publishing runs only,
needs site, acceptance and release-gates; deploy now needs it) downloads
the site job's retained artifact (the same site/ directory uploaded as
the Pages artifact), checks that SHA256SUMS lists exactly the served
files with well-formed lines and that every hash matches, then runs
actions/attest-build-provenance with subject-checksums. Pinned to
4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2 (resolved with
`git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/attest-build-provenance`:
v4.2.2 and v4^{} both point there; release.yml already pins the same).
The job holds only id-token: write and attestations: write, with no
checkout and no repository code. Signing the sums with the release key
stays owner-gated (OD-07); SRI is not applicable to a same-origin static
bundle under the meta CSP and is not added here.

attests the SHA256SUMS of the Pages artifact before deploying" ->
